Take Teachable, for instance. While it's a well-known platform for course creation and sales, it's not a solution for restricted countries. The same goes for Stripe, which operates in only 46 out of 195 countries on earth. PayPal, on the other hand, has a more widespread reach, but its account suspension policies can be draconian. Meanwhile, alternative platforms like Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy offer more flexibility, but their availability and fees can be unpredictable. In contrast, COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a permanent structural alternative to these platforms, with a stack of free and paid tools that gives creators full control over their online stores, payment processing, and data ownership.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Restricted countries are often left in the dark when it comes to digital commerce. Platforms like Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy either don't operate in these countries or impose severe restrictions. But COREMERCH's sovereignty-based approach means that digital creators can access the same tools and infrastructure, regardless of their location. With COREMERCH, creators can deploy a fully functional online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership, without relying on a single platform or country-specific infrastructure.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment speed and fees are critical considerations for digital creators. While platforms like Stripe and PayPal charge high transaction fees, COREMERCH's NOWPayments integration offers a 0.5% fee for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON, which can process transactions for under $0.10. Meanwhile, COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers end-to-end testing and 30-day support, ensuring that creators can get up and running quickly and efficiently.
Stripe's geographic exclusion list is a deliberate infrastructure decision — not a temporary gap waiting to be fixed.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the biggest advantages of COREMERCH's sovereignty-based approach is the level of ownership and control that digital creators have over their online stores and payment processing. With COREMERCH, creators can host their stores on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and store orders in Supabase or Google Sheets. This means that creators have full control over their data, can automate their payment processing and delivery, and can scale their businesses without relying on a single platform or country-specific infrastructure.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

When choosing an architecture for selling courses and digital products, digital creators have several options to consider. With COREMERCH, creators can deploy a fully functional online store with automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery, regardless of their location. By choosing the right combination of tools and infrastructure, creators can scale their businesses efficiently, reduce their costs, and maintain full control over their data and payment processing.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Sovereign infrastructure means no single platform decision can cut off your income — the store runs under your own accounts.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
